title: Emote 01
name: emote-01
arc:
A standing, non-contact KO: begin square to the camera with both feet planted and both arms relaxed at the sides. Let the shoulders soften and the chin drop, then gradually bow the head and upper body forward while the hands hang loosely beside the thighs. The defeat reads through the loss of posture, without a hit, fall, kneel or opponent.

Finish in the bowed, dejected pose and hold it. This is a one-shot with a terminal hold, so there is no return to the opening stance or loop seam. Preserve the recorded 15 frames at 12 fps; the 1.218-second marked window plays in 1.25 seconds, a small timing change explicitly accepted by the user.
